name.value: Frank's Pizza & Bar at Resurrection Spirits

description.value: Frank's Pies & Slices is a New York-inspired pizza restaurant tucked along North Commercial Drive in East Vancouver, operating out of the Resurrection Spirits space. The menu leans into creative, shareable pies with names like 'Notorious P.I.E.' and 'Silk Tracksuit', alongside share plates and late-night pizza slices. A cyclist finishing a ride along the nearby Commercial Drive corridor would find a lively, independently run spot well suited to a post-ride meal.

raw_osm.name: Frank's Pizza & Bar at Resurrection Spirits

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active with a full menu and online ordering, confirming the business is open; OSM check_date 2026-02-28 corroborates this. The OSM name 'Frank's Pizza & Bar at Resurrection Spirits' differs from the website's consistent branding 'Frank's Pies & Slices', and the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the postal code V5L 1P4 and the website's own description ('North Commercial Drive of Resurrection') place this firmly in East Vancouver. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears on the website; takeout is confirmed by 'ORDER ONLINE NOW' and pizza-by-the-slice offerings; vegetarian options are clearly present on the menu (e.g., The Green Monster pizza, arugula salad, olives).
concerns: OSM name 'Frank's Pizza & Bar at Resurrection Spirits' does not match website branding, which consistently uses 'Frank's Pies & Slices' throughout all pages.

OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but postal code V5L 1P4 and the website description ('North Commercial Drive of Resurrection') confirm the location is in East Vancouver, not North Vancouver.
Phone number +1-604-253-0059 listed in OSM could not be confirmed or denied from the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pizza restaurant on Commercial Drive in Vancouver with an active website and online ordering.
